name: Potato Rig RPG
hook: Overclock your grease-drenched spud rig to run the fast food fantasy RPG
tagline: A spud PC wired into an industrial fry vat boots up a pixelated fantasy realm while oil temps spike. Cashing out ejects a golden crispy combo basket and cool soft serve before combustion. Crashing causes the fry basket cooling rig to boil over in an explosion of smoking fry grease.
